description:
Stored OHLCV price bars for one S&P 500 ticker: open, high, low, close and volume per bar, each with its date.

    `interval` is `1d` (default) or `1h`. `range` limits the window to the last
    `5d`, `1mo`, `3mo`, `6mo`, `1y`, `2y` or `5y`; omitted, the full stored
    history for the interval is returned. `as_of` is the date of the latest bar.
    Measured prices only. Same payload as REST `GET /api/v1/prices/{ticker}`.
name: get_price_history
